landing.intro: Experienced and open-minded full-stack Django developer with four years of experience building and deploying web applications, backed by a strong foundation in computer science and applied mathematics. Proficient in Python, Django REST Framework, Vue.js, Nuxt, PostgreSQL, Git, and Docker. Excel at teamwork and collaboration. I am a team player with strong collaboration skills. I take a proactive approach to challenges and have a passion for trying out new technologies.
